e: ESBLs hydrolyse penicillins/cephalosporins but spare carbapenems → carbapenems remain the reliable treatment.
Vibrio cholerae uniquely possesses two circular chromosomes (chromosome I & II).
Assam + chronic cough + cavitary lung + caseating granulomas → consider histoplasmosis, a river-valley-endemic TB mimic.
Non-treponemal titres (VDRL/RPR) fall c̅ treatment, making them useful for monitoring disease response.
Diphtheria toxin ADP-ribosylates & inactivates elongation factor-2, halting host protein synthesis.
Catalase-positive GPC that's cefoxitin-sensitive = MSSA → cloxacillin is the drug of choice.
Poorly controlled diabetic c̅ facial pain & black nasal/palatal eschar → mucormycosis (Rhizopus).

Poly-D-glutamate capsule of B. anthracis is encoded on the pXO2 plasmid.
pXO1 instead encodes the toxin genes.
Necator americanus infects via skin penetration by filariform larvae (soil contact, e.g. bare feet).
Prions are NOT destroyed at 121°C for 15 min; need 134°C for ≥18 min (or NaOH exposure).
NALC-NaOH method: NALC = mucolytic (digests), NaOH = decontaminant for sputum AFB.
Cryptococcus neoformans: encapsulated budding yeast, capsule shown c̅ India ink/nigrosin; meningitis in immunocompromised.
Toxic shock syndrome toxin-1 is a superantigen: binds Vβ region of TCR + MHC II → massive T-cell activation and cytokine storm.

Trophozoites c̅ ingested RBCs = Entamoeba histolytica (invasive colitis).
Cryptosporidium shows acid-fast oocysts, not RBC-containing trophozoites.

Rheumatic heart disease follows Group A Streptococcus (S. pyogenes) pharyngitis 🫀
M-protein molecular mimicry → chronic mitral stenosis ("fish-mouth" valve).

Trichomonas vaginalis: motile, pear-shaped flagellated trophozoite c̅ undulating membrane (jerky motility); no cyst stage.
Clue cells = BV (Gardnerella); budding yeast = Candida.

Hookworm (Ancylostoma) larvae penetrate skin; animal hookworms (A. braziliense/caninum) cause cutaneous larva migrans.
Transmission is via skin penetration, not ingestion; Strongyloides shows larvae (not eggs) in stool.
